newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady ahead of PPI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady ahead of PPI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's 1330 GMT release of the U.S. November producer price index (PPI), which is forecast to show a gain of 0.3 percent compared with a 0.4 percent increase reported in October, dealers said on Wednesday.

"The market was steady to easier in the morning on some position adjustments. All eyes are on tonight's release of the (U.S. November) PPI figures, but I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday, Thursday/Friday and week-fixed were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among term rates, one-month was unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, three-months eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
